scope: Stage 0 script plus prospectively specified Stage 1/2; no new experiment executed

features.text: L2 normalized token masked mean then L2 normalization
features.video_length: all raw CLIP clips, no SlowFast or decoder truncation
features.alignment_gate: complete train features and extraction timestamps; video-cluster CI95 lower > 0.5
features.missing_timestamps: pending; nominal mapping is descriptive only
features.gate_failure: stop; separately register sentence-embedding extraction before attempting revised channel

aggregator_selection: inner_train pooled AUROC, ties in declared order; never Novel-dev

reference.source: inner_train unique exact query strings and unique video IDs, full Cartesian reference
reference.leave_self_out: exclude evaluation video from video reference and evaluation query from query reference when present; global mean uses both exclusions
reference.duplicate_query_encoding: must resolve nonidentical encoded tokens before query-only or within-query claims
reference.double_center: z_tilde=z-mu_q-mu_v+mu; arithmetic average of chosen z aggregator over reference

stage2.b: mean logit across five seeds; five video-group OOF folds for train, mean of five train models per seed for eval
stage2.cq_selection: held-in video-group validation from fitting portion only; no OOF labels for selection; Novel-dev never selects epoch
stage2.cq_recipe: V5 Cq hidden128, Adam lr0.001 wd0.0001, BCE natural proportions, batch32, max50 epochs, earliest AUROC tie
stage2.fit: inner_train class-balanced logistic regression with intercept, fixed b offset; ridge1e-4 on slopes, none on intercept
stage2.standardization: inner_train means and stds only; zero variance maps to zero
stage2.zero_fit: standardize b, mu_q, mu_v, z_tilde on train; equal-weight M2 and M3; report separately
controls: shuffled videos with centers recomputed and M2/M3 refitted

statistics.shuffle_assignment: unique video bijection without fixed points, shared by every row of a video within role; seeded circular shift of random ordering
statistics.macro_ci: paired video-cluster bootstrap; same video multiplicity across all folds, seeds not independent units
statistics.within_query: query-macro AUC for exact dual-label queries, incidence-component bootstrap; giant component means descriptive only
statistics.mde: Stage 0 pooled shuffled-score AUC is not the M3-minus-M2 null or MDE; requires full Stage 2 refit plus prespecified alternative/power simulation
statistics.mde_alternative: inject positive standardized z_tilde logit coefficient into M2-generated labels, retain cluster dependence in simulation; effect is model-dependent; freeze implementation before execution

N.interpretation: no usable increment detected in this channel and protocol; not proof of absence

decisions.insufficient_power: MDE > .02 or undefined: inconclusive, never relax threshold
decisions.otherwise: inconclusive; expand prespecified semantic holdout support before method work
decisions.wording: conditional compatibility additionally requires within-query CI lower > .5 and video-only control; otherwise evidence increment only

runtime_hours: unmeasured; 1-3 hours is planning estimate only
